_comment: Hints on a room's screens while Auto is off (routes/room_hints.py; owner, 28 Oct). Each hint names one show_service situations word (GET /show/api/v1/situations, its default params), how long it must hold (for_s), the modes the room may be in for it (from; absent = any mode it doesn't offer) and the modes it offers. The first hint that holds wins. It shows for show_s when it starts holding, again after again_after_s while it still holds, and goes at once when it stops (Auto on, a mode picked, the music stopped). Re-read when this file changes.

hints.title: Playing the piano?
hints.line: Auto is off, so the screens and lights aren't playing along.

hints.title: Music is playing
hints.line: Auto is off, so the screens and lights aren't following it.
